title: The live retained-bind test reads engram_budget_clock directly, bypassing the clock-boundary slice's single snapshot reader
outcome: src/tests/engram_root_recovery_live.rs reads the budget clock through StateInner::engram_budget_clock_snapshot(), honouring the one-reader contract w-8f9988de4cb3's slice 1 documents, so a later fixture clock choice fails at once there too.
acceptance: src/tests/engram_root_recovery_live.rs no longer reads inner.engram_budget_clock directly; it uses engram_budget_clock_snapshot().
The live suite's retained-bind test still compiles and its behaviour is unchanged.
